why_use_section.title: Why We Build with React Native
why_use_section.subtitle: React Native is a strong mobile development choice for businesses that need native app experiences, faster delivery, shared product logic, and maintainable cross-platform architecture.
paragraphs: Devisgon uses React Native for businesses that want to launch polished iOS and Android applications without building two completely separate native products from the beginning. It is suitable for startup MVPs, SaaS companion apps, service booking platforms, marketplaces, customer portals, internal field apps, fitness apps, education apps, and business workflow applications.

A successful React Native product requires more than screen development. Our approach focuses on app architecture, reusable components, TypeScript structure, navigation flows, API integration, authentication, offline-friendly behavior, native module requirements, performance optimization, app store readiness, analytics, testing, and long-term maintainability.
